falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any daily session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern analog would be broken; that bottom featured lower highs and contained price action below the breakdown zone—an immediate recovery to 5,600+ invalidates the structural damage thesis and suggests a V-bottom rather than the grinding, lower-bound consolidation typical of that analog

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 implies residual stress and forced-liquidation risk; sustained sub-14 VIX would indicate panic has fully cleared and dealers are re-leveraging short gamma, contradicting the 'bottom' phase which requires vol compression to occur *after* price basing, not before

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40bps from current level within 14 days without SPX making a new low below the August 2024 equivalent zone (~5,100)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern featured rates falling *alongside* equity capitulation; a rates rally without equity follow-through would signal a growth scare rather than a liquidity-driven bottom, breaking the cross-asset correlation structure that validates the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
